name: Dutchess Cannabis - Markham
how_menu_reached: Same Dutchie white-label storefront as the other Dutchess branches: dutchesscanna.com reverse-proxies /stores/markham-illinois to a Dutchie Next.js app. Menu is rendered first-party on the retailer host (no iframe, no plugin script). JSON-LD Store address '3063 W 159th St, Markham IL 60428' equals the registry address.
branch_selection: URL slug markham-illinois; SSR HTML contains "dispensaryId":"6852f6d104a7407146d06d5c","chainId":"dutchess"; all GraphQL variables carry that dispensaryId. getChainDispensaries lists id 6852f6d104a7407146d06d5c, name 'Dutchess IL - Markham', status open, phone (872) 871-5760, 3063 West 159th Street.

data_loading.mechanism: GraphQL over GET with Apollo persisted queries, same-origin /api-0/graphql on dutchesscanna.com
data_loading.notes: Home view only fetches collection-scoped FilteredProducts (collectionId set); whole menu requires the unscoped query. With the default sort ('popular', ties) pages overlap: union misses products. With sortBy name|price|createdAt and isDefaultSort=false pages are stable and the union equals totalCount exactly (tested: all three sorts and removeProductsBelowOptionThresholds=false gave 514/514). Same-origin raw GET needs a Referer header (404 without); dutchie.com raw API is behind a Cloudflare challenge (not evaded).

paging: page (0-based) + perPage (max 100). queryInfo.totalCount=514, totalPages=6 at perPage 100. Default popular sort: pages returned [100,99,99,99,100,14] and only 511 unique ids (3 short of declared total 514, duplicates across page boundaries). Deterministic sort: 514 unique = total. Category totals: Flower 175, Pre-Rolls 98, Edible 90, Vaporizers 65, Concentrate 25, Accessories 59 (sum 512 vs 514; the 2-item gap is the flower count wobble 174/175 plus unsorted/other types).
license_channels: recreational (pricingType rec); medical prices via parallel arrays. Registry serves_medical=0.
blockers: raw HTTP to dutchie.com graphql = Cloudflare challenge (403), not evaded

why_it_fails: Branch-page selection, not extraction. The name search ('Dutchess Cannabis' + city) returned sibling-branch pages of the same chain (oak-park, batavia, lynwood, morton-grove, plano, north-riverside) and dutchie.com hubs. inspect_page() correctly marks each 'conflict' because the JSON-LD addresses differ from the registry's Markham address. The Markham page itself (/stores/markham-illinois, address identical to the registry) was never among the (max 8) search results, and there is no CONNECTORS entry for 'dutchess' (resolution #176: 'No retailer locator connector configured') that could walk the chain hub to the right branch slug. A later fetch would still be only borderline complete: default-sort replay loses ~3 of 514 products, so the declared total would not reconcile.
fix_idea: (1) Chain connector ('dutchess' -> https://dutchesscanna.com/) or a Dutchie white-label locator using getChainDispensaries/branch slugs and matching by address+coordinates (shared with Lynwood, Oak Park, Maribis, Stashouse). Also have search results that are sibling branches of the same host trigger a hub walk instead of giving up (branch_slug_conflict already identifies them). (2) Dutchie replay: set isDefaultSort=false with sortBy=name (or price/createdAt) and removeProductsBelowOptionThresholds=false before paging, so unique ids == queryInfo.totalCount and the grade-A reconciliation can pass. Needs a regression fixture under tests/fixtures/.
